conventions.lines: 1-based; a line ends at \n or \r\n; a final line without a terminator counts
conventions.query: the words sent to the engine are `query` when present, else `question`
conventions.parts: every part is one thing a complete answer cites; any one of a part's ranges satisfies it
conventions.files: every path named in any part; `files` is empty exactly for no-answer questions
conventions.range_inside_passage: a range is found when a returned passage has the same path and start_line <= range start and range end <= end_line
conventions.keys: each key occurs, case-folded, in the text of the range's lines joined by newlines
conventions.checks: absent_from_corpus: no file holds the word as a token; absent_from_files: none of `files` holds it as a token (repository analyzer)

word-form.what: a different form of a word the file holds (plural, tense, inflection)

misspelt.what: a misspelt word; the file holds the right spelling

phrase.what: an exact phrase; its words also occur apart in other files

two-passages.what: the answer spans two passages of one file

filename.what: the question is about the file's name, not its text

no-answer.what: nothing in the folder answers; the right result is nothing
